health.piece: Known issue: Ratcliffe - no week-by-week playoff numbers
health.what: FTN gives this week plus one rest-of-season total (through Week 17), not Week 15-17 one by one. Later weeks use his season rate spread over the games a man is available for (byes and injury returns counted); matchup strength in those weeks still comes from the engine, not Ratcliffe.

health.piece: Known issue: Ratcliffe - graded from Week 8 only
health.what: The scoreboard starts grading Ratcliffe with Week 8 (his pregame numbers are frozen from the 10:10 AM Oct 28 read). Until a few weeks are in, his accuracy line is a small sample; the RATCLIFFE MEN line compares all four sources on the same men.
